summary: Critical gaps: fixture files (fixtures/commits_*.txt) and pytest tests (tests/ dir) referenced but not provided; run_act_tests.sh cannot execute without them. Requirement 'All tests must be runnable and must pass' unmet. Python script has solid error handling and modular design but lacks docstrings on _split_commits/_read_commits_file. Bash script hardcodes test data (lines 14-17) instead of data-driving, reducing maintainability. No actionlint validation proof. Workflow YAML is well-structured (checkout@v4, minimal permissions) but lacks explicit error handling and shell specification.
